label: 再次购买意愿
include: will buy/order again、would purchase again等未发生表达。
exclude: 不能计实际复购。
example_quote: will order again

label: 明确已发生再次购买
include: 明确second purchase、went back and ordered second set。
exclude: 仅持有三套不能证明分几次购买；不验证订单真实性。
example_quote: This is my 2nd purchase of these sheets.

label: 同款既往与本次购买自述
include: 明确先前买过同款，且在比较当前新购款体验。
exclude: 保留推理链和不同于明确second purchase的证据强度。
example_quote: I have ordered these exact same sheets in the light purple

label: 已买多套，订单次数未知
include: bought three sets或now have three sets。
exclude: 不等同同单多件、不同订单复购或三个独立买家。
example_quote: I have bought 3 sets now.

label: 已购多颜色，订单次数未知
exclude: 不自动推断同单或复购。
example_quote: We got the dark green and dark blue color.

label: 已为家人购买
include: 明确bought one for my daughter。
exclude: 不直接等同赠礼、生日礼物或同单购买。
example_quote: bought one for my daughter as well!!

label: 礼物用途／赠送意图
exclude: 不表示已经赠送或收礼者使用满意。
example_quote: This is supposed to be a birthday gift for my son

label: 家庭换新意愿
include: 明确将家里床品替换为该产品的计划。
exclude: 不计已经购买多套。
example_quote: I will be replacing all of the sheet sets in my house with these.

label: 替换旧床品意愿
exclude: 不计已完成换新或新增订单。
example_quote: We’ll officially be tossing out our old sheets and replacing them with these!

label: 添购其他尺寸意愿
include: 明确going to buy twin sets等。
exclude: 不计已发生跨规格复购。
example_quote: I’m going to buy some twin sets!

label: 正在退货／提出退货行动
exclude: 不计退款已完成。
example_quote: I’m returning these

label: 已经提出退货请求
exclude: 不等于已获批准、已寄回或已退款。
example_quote: I am requesting a return

label: 条件性退货意愿
exclude: 不计确定退货或条件已成立。
example_quote: if they are not cooling, I will be returning them.

label: 拒绝再购意愿
exclude: 不推断已经流失或终身不再购买。
example_quote: Will not be purchasing these again at all!

label: 减少使用意愿
include: will not be using very often。
exclude: 不把计划当实际频次。
example_quote: will not be using very often in my rotation.

label: 转向其他品牌意愿
exclude: 不计竞品订单已经发生。
example_quote: Going with my old brand bedsure!

label: 明确再次购买理由
include: 明确came back for another color。
exclude: 不倒推首次购买理由。
example_quote: I came back for another color for winter.

label: 材料期待，未证明选择原因
exclude: 未说因此选择购买，不能计明确购买理由。
example_quote: i thought it would be like mostly bamboo and something else like cotton

label: 明确购买理由：凉感
exclude: 不计实际凉感成功，也不证明销量因果。
example_quote: I purchased these bamboo sheets because they are “supposed to be cooling and temperature regulating”.

label: 凉感期待，未证明选择原因
include: 明确期待凉感或自述怕热。
exclude: 不升级成唯一或已经证明的购买原因。
example_quote: I am quite a warm sleeper, so I was looking forward to the “cooling” effect of these sheets.

label: 明确促销触发购买
include: saw sale and jumped on them等行动关联。
exclude: 不证明促销单独造成增量或销量主因。
example_quote: finally saw they went on sale and jumped on them

label: 视频形成期待
exclude: 没有明确购买因果句时，不称该视频促成订单。
example_quote: Was excited about these sheets after watching videos and seeing that they are cooling and soft.

label: 明确评价影响购买
exclude: 不能确认某条评价的贡献或真实凉感。
example_quote: I bought them because of reviews saying that the sheets are cooling.

label: 内容影响线索，指向未明
exclude: 不能确认具体内容、渠道或当次购买归因。
example_quote: I hate being influenced on here
